purpose.summary: A CICS online transaction program (CW08DEMO) that performs employee record cancellation/annulment operations against a DB2 table (CWDIPENDENTI). It uses a BMS map (MF08MAP) for screen I/O and temporary storage queues for passing data between transactions.

notable_features: EXEC SQL with DB2 cursor (CUR-DIP) against CWDIPENDENTI table
EXEC CICS for BMS map handling and temporary storage
DFHCOMMAREA / EIBCALEN linkage for CICS pseudo-conversational pattern
COPY DFHAID, COPY CWATTRIB, COPY CWMESS, COPY CWCOMMA (standard CICS copybooks)
Italian-language comments and field names (Italian banking/HR demo system)
Temporary storage queue (CPSCODA) for inter-transaction data passing
Line sequence numbers in columns 73-80 (IBM mainframe style)
